changes.comment: ai-assist: proxied entry points no longer silently discard parameters they declare. `endpoint` is now REFUSED on all five (completion, completion stream, embedding, image generation, list-models) rather than ignored — a proxy cannot confirm it honored it, and silently reaching the provider's default upstream would send the request somewhere the caller excluded; use the direct entry point, or point the proxy itself at the intended upstream. This is a behavior change for any caller that was passing `endpoint` to a proxied call: it previously appeared to work and did not. `tier` is now resolved client-side on both completion paths and sent through the existing modelOverride field, so a frontier request no longer runs on the base model and an already-deployed proxy needs no update. On callProxiedCompletion, `adaptOptionalToNullable` also rides along in the structuredOutput projection, and `usage` is read back from the proxy response through a new validating aiCompletionUsage converter. callProxiedListModels's `capabilityConfig` remains a documented no-op rather than a refusal, since the proxy returns models already classified. Separately, the proxied stream's published contract now states which four of the seven IAiStreamEvent variants it carries.
